_help: The MENU window (UI/UITotalMenu.img/main art). x/y = the window spot in 1366x768 game pixels, w/h = the window size (it must match the art). titleH = the strip above the tabs that drags the window. col0X..col6X = the seven column spots (the blue tabs), col0Rows..col6Rows = how many menu items the column has. row0Y..row8Y = the item row spots. bot0X..bot6X/botY = the bottom row of seven buttons (their WZ origins are the negative of these spots). closeX/closeY = the X button. stripX/stripY/stripW/stripH = the quick menu strip inside the art (it is drawn translucent, like the glass), stripAlpha = how much of it stays.
